fallback.text: A MOSFET dissipates 20 W at an ambient of 40 °C. Heat flows from the junction through the case (0.5 K/W) and the thermal pad (0.2 K/W) into the heatsink, then into the air through the heatsink's own resistance Rsa. In the steady state Tj = 40 °C + 20 W × (0.7 K/W + Rsa), so Tj stays at or below 125 °C when Rsa ≤ 3.55 K/W. The picture shows Rsa = 3.5 K/W: the junction warms to 124 °C over a few minutes while the heatsink, with most of the heat capacity, sets the pace.
